card.name: Concentration words in drug interactions
card.fires_on: Nouns for drug amount or effect, such as concentrations, peak, levels, exposure and effectiveness, in drug-interaction text. They come right after words like peak, the, effect on or blood.

modes.label: Peak/concentration terms
modes.description: Word for blood amount of a drug, in pharmacokinetic interaction sentences.
modes.example: azolam (1 mg BID) and nefazodone (200 mg BID) were coadministered, steady-state<< peak>> concentrations, AUC and half-life values

modes.label: Levels or effectiveness after an interacting drug
modes.description: Noun that names what an enzyme inducer or inhibitor changes.
modes.example: Co-administration with ciprofloxacin may increase blood<< levels>> of zolpidem, concurrent use

modes.label: Concentration in table headings
modes.description: Start of the word concentration in interaction table headers.
modes.example: Concomitant Drug Class: Drug Name Effect on<< Concent>>ration Clinical Comment HIV-1 Antiv
